messages:
sasha: Quick pulse — catalog launch readiness for two open models: zephyrX and ember-7b. Owners @kim @maria @jon. Are licensing + perf badges green? Any blockers for canary next Tue?

kim: ZephyrX perf profile uploaded. A100-40 q4_0: median throughput ~220 tok/s, P99 ~110ms at batch=8. Ember7b quantized run drops ~15% vs fp16; memory tight on 80GB with kv cache. I'll post perf gist.

kim: PERF CMD:
```
./bench --model zephyrX --device A100 --quant q4_0 --batch 8 --out perf.json
```

maria: License check: ZephyrX is Apache-2.0 ✅ Ember7b is MIT but includes a third_party NOTICE — legal needs the NOTICE file included in distro. I flagged license in the model metadata.

clare-legal: Confirming Maria's note. Also need a one-paragraph provenance blurb for Ember7b (origin, any modified files). Can someone drop that here?

jon: Infra/status: Staging cluster is green for zephyrX canary, but one node group shows driver mismatch (nvidia 525 vs 530) causing ~5% perf regression under stress. I've queued a nodepool rolling update for tonight. No SLA impact expected.

andrew: Are runtimes backward compatible? Any model repo format changes that'll break deploy automation?

kim: No repo format changes. Just added optional "license_notice" field. Deploy tooling will ignore if absent.

sasha: Great. Next steps: kim to confirm updated perf badge, maria/clare to sign off on license + provenance, jon to finish nodepool roll. If all ✅, canary deploy Tue 03:00 PT. Who's oncall for the window?

jon: I'll be primary, @andrew backup. :thumbsup:

dl-deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: zephyrX -> canary group at 2026-03-18T03:00:00-07:00. Track: https://deploys.internal/reports/3133700000

maria: I've attached the NOTICE and provenance snippet in the model metadata now. Ping if legal wants changes.

sasha: Awesome, thanks everyone. Closing the pulse — will post final launch checklist Fri.
